title: CIIR - Class-Indexed Interface Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23151v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal learning commonly assumes paired or synchronized observations, yet independently collected datasets rarely provide such correspondence. We introduce CIIR, a modular encoder--decoder framework that connects heterogeneous datasets through a class-indexed address space while preserving each dataset's native input format and output module. A known local index selects address $k$, and an input-dependent 128-dimensional address representation Z_k(x) is written to that address. To demonstrate CIIR, we learn this address space from handwritten digits, clothing images, spoken-digit spectrograms, and hand signs without synchronized or instance-matched samples. Newly trained label-free receivers recover the requested addresses with 94.7% macro-average Address Realization Accuracy. We then attach the unseen SVHN dataset after freezing the base address space and train only lightweight adapters, achieving 90.2% MNIST>SVHN and 82.3% SVHN>MNI

translated_abstract: 多模态学习通常假设存在成对或同步的观测数据，然而独立收集的数据集很少能提供这种对应关系。我们提出CIIR，这是一个模块化的编码器-解码器框架，通过类索引地址空间连接异构数据集，同时保留每个数据集的原生输入格式和输出模块。一个已知的本地索引用于选择地址k，随后将与输入相关的128维地址表示Z_k(x)写入该地址。为了展示CIIR，我们在没有同步或实例匹配样本的情况下，从手写数字、服装图像、口述数字频谱图和手语手势中学习该地址空间。新训练的无标签接收器以94.7%的宏平均地址实现准确率成功恢复所请求的地址。随后，我们在冻结基础地址空间后接入未见过的SVHN数据集，仅训练轻量级适配器，实现了90.2%的MNIST>SVHN和82.3%的SVHN>MNIST迁移性能。
tldr: CIIR提出了一种模块化编码器-解码器框架，利用类索引地址空间在无需配对样本的情况下连接异构数据集，并在冻结基础地址空间后仅通过轻量级适配器即可扩展至新数据集。
en_tdlr: CIIR is a modular encoder-decoder framework that connects heterogeneous datasets without paired samples through a class-indexed address space, and enables extension to new datasets using only lightweight adapters after freezing the base address space.
